name: Improved Bear Paw (Combat)
body:
Your methods of wielding oversized weapons are powerful and precise.

Prerequisite: Str 13, Bear Paw, base attack bonus +6, ursine.

Benefit: You can use a melee weapon in your off-hand that is one size larger than you without penalty. Alternatively, you may wield a two-handed weapon in your primary hand that is made for your size without a penalty.
